name: public_detectors_celebdf_official_smoothing_v1

recce.implementation: DeepfakeBench reproduction, not original one-logit RECCE paper checkpoint

ucf.implementation: DeepfakeBench UCF ICCV2023, Xception common-forgery inference head

selfi.implementation: author public SELFI CLIP B16 + ArcFace full checkpoint
selfi.normalization_source: published SELFI_clip.yaml; trained checkpoint contains no training config; not plain OpenAI CLIP normalization
selfi.training_provenance_limit: README describes FF++ c23 training; YAML template lists FF-NT. Exact training subset is not embedded in the raw checkpoint.

crop_limit: Reuse existing native MTCNN1.5x crops. Upstream RECCE uses RetinaFace and benchmark/SELFI preprocessing uses aligned crops; this is a paired sensitivity evaluation, not exact paper reproduction.
claim_limit: External FF++ detector performance not directly ranked against self-trained Celeb-DF models on a different test. Synthetic smoothing, not official Instagram filters.
